title: LET US PRAISE THE GOD WHO CREATED THE WORLD IN THE BEGINNING

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth." Genesis 1:1

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The time calculation of the word "In the beginning" is a profound mystery that cannot be determined by man. In God's vast creation, all provisions were made specifically for man during the first five days.
Why were such a huge world and all its comforts handed over to a tiny human? The Creator's plan was that all these things should be placed under his authority. He knew beforehand to whom this world truly belonged. When we see that such a great God has given everything to such a small human, how true it is that "our God is marvelous!"
In the presence of God, human life never becomes meaningless. The seal of His love is perfectly imprinted in everything He has created.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "No one who trusts in the Almighty God ever becomes small; He has graciously given us great blessings as our own."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Loving Heavenly Father, we thank You for creating the heavens and the earth in the beginning, and for blessing us by placing us under Your authority. You sustain us by giving such a great world and all its blessings to us who are small. We praise You for Your marvelous grace. In Jesus' name, we pray, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Dear brother/sister, you play a vital role in this magnificent world. The God who takes care of you without any lack is with you. Move forward in faith.
